title: A tarot deck of machining sins: chatter, crashed tool, forgotten work offset
summary: A wry inventory of machining failure modes as tarot cards — what each sin looks like, how it starts, and the one habit that breaks the spell.

blocks.title: Draw a card. Admit the sin. Fix the habit.
blocks.body: Every shop has a deck of repeating disasters. These cards are not mysticism — they are failure modes with better costumes. Pull one, recognize yourself, and change the setup before the next blank is ruined.

blocks.heading: The three major arcana of regret

columns.name: Chatter
columns.detail: The machine sings a song you did not request. Surface waves, broken edges, ego damage.

columns.name: Crashed tool
columns.detail: Geometry meets unexpected coordinate. Spindle stops caring about your schedule.

columns.name: Forgotten work offset
columns.detail: The program is innocent. Your G54 is living in last Tuesday.

blocks.heading: The deck
rows: Shorten stickout; change SFPM; clamp like you mean it
Mandatory dry run on new setups
Clean jaws; adequate pressure; stop blocks
Announce units out loud at setup
Probe or indicator after any crash/bump
Jog in proper increment; know where tool tip is
Air blast / coolant / pause to clear
One photo + offset list on the job cart
blocks.caption: Fictional deck for teaching. Your shop may deal extra local cards.

slides.title: Past — The Dry-Run Skipper
slides.body: You shipped a revision on Friday nerves. The card remembers.

slides.title: Present — The Lost Offset
slides.body: The vise moved. G54 did not get the memo.

slides.title: Future — The Crashed Tool (reversed)
slides.body: If you single-block the first toolpath and re-indicate, this card stays in the deck unused.

items.label: Work offset matches the indicated surface
items.detail: Say the G54 numbers out loud once.

items.label: Tool lengths match the carousel reality
items.detail: Especially after a crash or tool change scramble.

items.label: First moves single-block / graph as required
items.detail: Rapids into stock are not a personality trait.

blocks.quote: The machine is not cursed. Your checklist is incomplete.
blocks.attribution: Shop proverb, embroidered on a rag

blocks.heading: Name that card
blocks.prompt: The program ran fine yesterday. Overnight the vise was removed and remounted. First cut today plunges into stock. Which card?
blocks.explanation: Remount without refreshing work offset is classic Forgotten Work Offset energy.

blocks.heading: Draw responsibly
blocks.body: Print the deck table. Circle the card you drew last month. Put the counter-habit on the setup sheet.
